title: Media assembly: one time base, verified frame counts, no blind concat, audio continuity, finish once
note: Synthetic. Lists the function exercised, the input and the expected outcome; authored, not run. No number here is a measurement of real rendering, latency, memory or cost.

calls.case: three clips, same codec/pix_fmt/size/fps/colour, frames 60+60+60, total_frames 180
one clip at 30000/1001 among 30/1 clips; one clip bt601; one with different pix_fmt
expect_alpha premultiplied with a yuv420p clip
visual-only edit with a mix receipt whose digests match; the same with timing_changed null; the same with a changed score digest
a scene-render node that already carries a finish

expect: each mismatch is a named problem and the concat is refused (re-encode to one intermediate spec is not implemented, and the message says so)
a frame total mismatch is refused
an intermediate without alpha is refused when premultiplied or straight alpha is the convention
audio is reused only when mix-receipt reuseDecision says reuse true; unknown timing is never treated as visual-only; a changed score digest remaps and re-verifies
the film-wide finish is applied once over the assembled picture; a fragment that was already finished is reported in double_apply_risk and per-fragment finishing is refused
